To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the expression of the wildtype c-kit gene in Kasumi 1 cells is suppressed as a result of the inhibition of AML1 Eto gene expression, and the suppression of c-kit gene expression is accompanied by a reduction in the number of cells with a high proliferative activity.
the inhibition of AML1 E TO expression in Kasumi 1 cells leads to a reduction of the expression of the wildtype c kit gene.

the suppression of AML1 E TO gene expression in Kasumi 1 cells by shRNA leads to the inhibition of the KIT gene expression and to a reduction in the proliferation and viability of the transduced cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the expression profile of genes in Kasumi 1 cells with the suppressed expression of the A ML1 ETO oncogenic fusion gene.

the identification and analysis of the expression profiles of the genes that are involved in the regulation of the differentiation of leukemic blast cells and that are controlled by the AML1ETO oncogene.
the identification of the genes whose expression changes as a result of the suppression of the AML 1 ETO gene.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

RNA interference (RNAi) is a powerful tool for studying the function of the genes involved in the pathogenesis of leukemia and for identifying the genes that are responsible for the malignant transformation of hematopoietically active cells [6, 7].
the AML1-ETO protein plays a crucial role in leukemogenesis, but the mechanisms of this process are not yet fully understood.
RNAi is a promising method for the study of the role of individual genes in the process of hematopoiet ic differentiation and malignant transformation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we used the lentiviral vector system to suppress the expression of AML1 ETo in Kasumi 1 cells.

, in this study we have used the lentiviral vector pLKO.1, in which the shRNA expression cassette is under the control of the U6 promoter, and we used the pLKO. 1 plasmid with the shRNA sequence directed against the AML1 gene (pLKO.1 shAML1) as a control.

we used a combination of RNA interference (RNAi) with high throughput RNA sequencing (RNA seq) for the first time for the identification of genes involved in the development of AML with the t(21;8) trans location.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in addition to KIT, the expression of a number of genes is also controlled by AML 1 ETO and that these genes are involved in the process of leukemogenesis.
the expression of the oncogene AML 1 ETO is a key regulator of the expression of many genes, including the c kit gene.
the use of lentiviral shRNAs directed against AML1 E TO allows us to significantly reduce the level of the c kit proto oncogene in Kasumi 1 cells.
